name: QueueSort
author: RapidMark
about: Re-sorts the download queue whenever an NZB is added, newest posts first by default.
description: Sonarr and Radarr add releases in whatever order they find them, so a new episode can wait behind a week of old remuxes.
This sorts the whole queue each time something is added, using NZBGet's own sort. Priorities still come first.

options.name: SortOrder
description: age+ = newest posts first. Also possible: name, priority, category, size, left (each with + or -).
